procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine DM/HTN visit. Admits the holidays and the cold snap did him in: more takeout, no walking, snacking now that he isn't smoking. Still smoke-free, 8 months. CPAP nightly. Missed a few evening metformin doses in December, back on track.

Vitals as charted. Weight up since the fall. BP a bit high again.

Heart RRR. Lungs clear. No edema. Feet intact.

A/P
T2DM: A1c today, suspect it drifted up. If over 7.5 we can talk about adding something, but he would like a few months of trying first, which is fair.
HTN: 138/88, keep lisinopril 20 for now, cut back on salty takeout, recheck in June.
Weight: set a goal of walking 20 min at lunch on site days.
RTC 4 mo.

documents.title: A1c result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your A1c is 7.6, up from 7.0 last summer. Kidneys and potassium are fine. As we agreed, let's give the food and walking changes until June and recheck then before adding anything.

documents.title: RE: A1c result
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Figured. Back to packing lunches. See you in June

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Annual dilated eye exam for diabetes, 2025-04-24.
Corrected acuity 20/20 right, 20/25 left, unchanged. Anterior segments quiet. Dilated fundus exam: no retinal hemorrhage, no exudate, no neovascularization, maculae flat, both eyes.
Assessment: no diabetic retinopathy. Next exam one year.
Allergies: NKDA.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
DM f/u. Back to lunches from home and walking the site perimeter at noon. Down a little over a kilo. One year without cigarettes this week.

BP improved, as charted. Heart regular, lungs clear, no edema.

A1c drawn; will message.

Plan: no change to metformin, lisinopril 20, atorvastatin 40, aspirin. Physical in the fall.

documents.title: A1c
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c 7.3, heading the right way. Keep doing what you're doing.

documents.title: Refill request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Mail-order pharmacy request: lisinopril 20 and atorvastatin 40, out of refills. Seen 6/9. Approved 90 days x1 to carry him to the physical; metformin still has a refill left.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly visit, now 40. Doing well overall. Smoke-free 15 months. Walking most workdays. CPAP every night, new mask in the spring. Drinks 2-3 beers a week. No exertional symptoms on site. No GI or GU complaints. Mood fine.

Current meds: metformin 1000 mg BID, lisinopril 20 mg daily, atorvastatin 40 mg at bedtime, aspirin 81 mg daily. No drug allergies.

Physical: vitals per flowsheet. Ears, throat normal. No lymphadenopathy. Thyroid normal size. Cardiac exam regular, no murmurs or gallops. Lungs clear to bases. Abdomen soft, no organomegaly. Skin unremarkable. Monofilament and vibration intact both feet, pedal pulses palpable, nails trimmed.

PHQ-2 0, AUDIT-C 2.

Assessment and plan
1. Type 2 diabetes: A1c, urine microalbumin, CMP drawn. Continue metformin.
2. Hypertension: controlled, same dose.
3. Statin and aspirin continued.
4. OSA on CPAP, adherent.
5. Former smoker.
6. Flu and COVID given today. Hep B series complete, PCV20 done, Tdap 2023.
7. Colorectal screening due at 45.
Next: diabetes visit in January.

documents.title: Lab results from your physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Results are in. A1c 7.2. Cholesterol at goal on the atorvastatin. Kidney, liver and blood counts normal. Urine shows no protein leak. All good. January for the next check.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Quiet winter, laid off for two weeks over the holidays as usual, held his weight this year. Taking meds. No lows. CPAP nightly.
O: BP and weight as charted. RRR, lungs clear, feet without lesions, sensation intact.
A: T2DM near goal; HTN controlled; obesity stable; OSA on CPAP.
P: A1c and BMP today. Same meds. 5-month follow-up, eye exam due in April.

documents.title: January labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: A1c 7.1, kidney function and potassium normal. Steady. See you late spring.

documents.title: Diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body: Diabetic eye evaluation, 2026-04-16. Best corrected 20/20 OD, 20/25 OS. IOP within normal limits OU. Dilated exam: discs pink with sharp margins, no retinopathy, no macular edema, both eyes. Plan: return in 1 year. No known allergies.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt texted to cancel tomorrow, inspection on one of his jobs. Rebooked for Wed 6/24 at 7:30.
